text:
Sam: Heads-up — I'm seeing a dip in webinar-to-SQL conversion in this week's KPI snapshot vs last month. dashboard: https://dash.redwood-inference.com/marketing/kpis/snapshot-2026-03-22
Lina: can you paste the cohort and filter you're looking at? I usually view `30d cohort (registrations)` + `first_touch` attribution.
Sam: Looking at `registrations -> SQL` for cohort week starting 2026-03-08, filters: source:webinar, medium:email, country:US. Conversion fell from 8.2% -> 5.1%.
Asha: interesting — our email open rate for that webinar was 12% lower (mailer sends had higher bounces). Might be a list quality issue.
Diego: not ruling out attribution mismatch. GA4 import shows similar volumes but the imported UTM parsing drops `utm_content`. can cause different session stitching.
Tara: quick idea: include both `first_touch` and a simple `weighted_last_2` in the weekly slide so execs see model sensitivity. avoids argument about which is "true".
Mark: Agree. Also let's sanity-check registration duplicates — last webinar we had a surge from one partner-linked landing page that duplicated params.
Sam: ran a fast SQL check for duplicate email + created_at within 5m window: ```sql
SELECT email, COUNT(*) as dup_count
FROM raw.registrations
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-08' AND '2026-03-14'
GROUP BY email
HAVING dup_count > 1;
```
Sam: result: 64 duplicate pairs, mostly from partner page A where the thank-you redirect added a query param.
Lina: I'll patch the ETL normalization to strip partner redirect params and reprocess that day range. will post when done.
Diego: GA-Bot: Import job 2026-03-22-13:05 finished. Sessions: 12,420. UTM mismatches: 342 rows flagged.
GA-Bot: Note: flagged rows have `utm_content` present only in click tags; server event has `utm_term` only. Manual reconciliation needed.
Asha: For the brief, I'll add a table: raw vs de-duped vs GA-reconciled counts and a short recommendation: tighten email list hygiene + add hidden honeypot to partners.
Tara: Let's A/B subject lines for the next webinar send (Mark will run). also start a small re-engagement send to the bounced subset.
Mark: will A/B test and report CTR/registration lift; targeting smaller groups first.
Lina: ETL reprocess started, estimated finish in 45m. I saved a snapshot view: `KPI - Webinar Cohort (deduped, multi-attrib)` link: https://dash.redwood-inference.com/marketing/views/kpi-webinar-deduped
Sam: OK — once reprocess is in, can we lock the public weekly deck and publish an annotated slide that explains model differences? want to avoid surprise questions in the all-hands.
Asha: yep. draft note for slide: "KPI numbers include a de-duplication pass and we show both first-touch and weighted-last-2 attribution for transparency. See appendix for raw counts and GA reconciliation."
Diego: quick ask to analytics: can someone export the GA flagged rows for me? I'll run a join and produce a reconciliation CSV.
Mark: pinged analytics.
Lina: reprocess done — numbers updated in `marketing.webinar_kpis_v2`. Snapshot saved and shared. deploy-bot: view snapshot `kpi-webinar-20260322` created.
Sam: thanks everyone. next steps: Mark runs A/B, Lina keeps ETL normalization in runbook, Asha finalizes slide, Diego publishes reconciliation CSV. we'll sync tomorrow morning for publish decision. :white_check_mark:
